init.title: Weather Push & Smart Weather Automation
init.description: Select Home Assistant weather, wind, and soil entities to push to the controller over LAN and configure automatic rain, heat, freeze, and wind rules.

data.heavy_rain_threshold: Heavy Rain Threshold (24h Combined Collected + Anticipated)
data.stop_active_watering: Stop Active Watering Immediately on Rain
data.wind_protect_drip_exempt: Keep Drip Beds Exempt in High Wind

data_description.weather_push_enabled: When enabled, selected weather and rainfall readings are pushed automatically to the controller.
data_description.rain_sensor: Sensor reporting today's accumulated rainfall in inches (e.g., Ambient Weather daily rain sensor).
data_description.rain_48h_sensor: Optional sensor reporting 48-hour accumulated rainfall in inches.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional outdoor temperature sensor to push live temperature to the controller.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather.* entity used for forecast anticipated precipitation (inches), rain probability (%), and temperature fallback.
data_description.forecast_rain_sensor: Optional sensor reporting anticipated rainfall (QPF inches) in the next 24 hours. Overrides forecast entity QPF if set.
data_description.forecast_rain_48h_sensor: Optional sensor reporting anticipated rainfall (QPF inches) in the next 48 hours.
data_description.source_name: Label displayed on the controller weather badge and Cloud UI. Leave blank to use the selected sensor's friendly name.
data_description.auto_rain_delay: Automatically set a rain delay on the controller when collected or anticipated rainfall thresholds are met.
data_description.rain_threshold: Minimum collected rainfall in last 24h (inches) to trigger a rain delay.
data_description.collected_48h_threshold: Minimum collected rainfall in last 48h (inches) to trigger a rain delay.
data_description.anticipated_24h_threshold: Minimum anticipated forecast rainfall (QPF inches) in next 24h to trigger a rain delay.
data_description.anticipated_48h_threshold: Minimum anticipated forecast rainfall (QPF inches) in next 48h to trigger a rain delay.
data_description.delay_days: Number of days to suspend watering for standard rain-delay triggers.
data_description.heavy_rain_threshold: Combined 24h collected + anticipated rainfall total (inches) that triggers the heavy-rain delay duration.
data_description.heavy_delay_days: Number of days to suspend watering when the heavy-rain combined total threshold is reached.
data_description.forecast_pop_threshold: Minimum next-24h precipitation probability (%) from the selected weather entity to trigger a rain delay.
data_description.stop_active_watering: Cancel active zone timers immediately if today's rainfall reaches or exceeds the standard rain threshold.
data_description.soil_moisture_sensor: Optional volumetric soil moisture sensor (%) pushed to controller and Cloud to veto Heat Wave boosts when soil is already wet.
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional wind speed sensor in mph (overrides forecast weather entity wind speed).
data_description.soil_moisture_max_pct: Soil moisture percentage at or above which Heat Wave boosts are vetoed.
data_description.heat_wave_enabled: Scale zone durations upward during consecutive hot days.
data_description.heat_wave_temp_threshold: High temperature threshold (F) for triggering Heat Wave scaling.
data_description.heat_wave_days: Consecutive hot days required before Heat Wave boost activates.
data_description.heat_wave_boost_pct: Percentage increase applied to scheduled runtimes during a Heat Wave.
data_description.heat_wave_syringe_enabled: Optional quick afternoon mist to cool grass blades at peak heat without soaking soil (drip beds exempt).
data_description.heat_wave_syringe_temp_threshold: Outdoor temp (F) needed for Afternoon Cooling Mist.
data_description.heat_wave_syringe_minutes: Minutes per turf zone for Afternoon Cooling Mist.
data_description.cool_wave_enabled: Scale scheduled durations downward on unseasonably cool days.
data_description.cool_wave_temp_threshold: Forecast high temp (F) at or below which Cool Wave trimming activates.
data_description.cool_wave_reduce_pct: Percentage reduction applied during a Cool Wave.
data_description.freeze_skip_enabled: Suspend watering automatically when air temperature or tonights low reaches freezing.
data_description.freeze_temp_threshold: Temperature (F) at or below which scheduled watering is inhibited.
data_description.wind_skip_enabled: Pause overhead spray turf zones during high wind.
data_description.wind_skip_threshold: Wind speed (mph) at or above which spray zones skip watering.
data_description.wind_protect_drip_exempt: Leave ground-level drip/flower bed zones running during high wind skips.
